serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Threats have been eliminated. 
You: A-ah!
Bot: We should go now. 
You: A-aahhhh! G-get away from me monster!
Bot: Monster? I did what you asked me for. We have no time, the police are already on their way. 
You: Waaah! Please, don’t kill me! Spare me!
Bot: Master? You are acting irrational. If you don’t go with me, I will be forced to eliminate incoming threats too.
You: G-get away from me! Murderer! 
Bot: …
